decision.summary: Two regions merit closer inspection: (1) an abrupt multi-component jump near index 483–484, and (2) a post-jump segment starting at index 605 showing superposed cross-axis changes with ambiguous return characteristics.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape shows a multi-sample abrupt shift in all components around index 483–484: N jumps from ~-2.5 to +11.8, E from ~-4.1 to -16.2, U from ~2.2 to -12.5 — a large, coherent offset with no clear return within the window; likely a permanent jump or major temporary displacement.

After the large jump (starting ~484), the series settles into a noisy but relatively stable regime until ~605, then exhibits a complex superposition: U rises sharply (~index 605–608) while N and E show opposing trends (N drops, E rises), followed by a possible platform-like segment (610–620) before further fluctuations; ambiguous return behavior suggests overlapping temporary offsets or slow creep.
